description: This photograph depicts a highly artificial coniferous plantation, specifically pine trees, located in the north west of Spain. The trees are planted in distinct, evenly spaced rows, characteristic of a cultivated stand or monoculture, with sparse, dry yellowish-brown ground vegetation. The sky is clear blue. The image exemplifies the classification of "Highly artificial coniferous plantations" used in land use/land cover inventories. The photograph is credited to Eurostat, 2012, originating from the LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) programme.
